reviewer: fresh-context subagent (general-purpose), release-cut review, adversarial on version-consistency and semver level

boundary.evidence: git diff main shows ONLY version-string lines changed (1.3.1->1.3.2); no gate/schema/logic lines touched. gate-manifest diff is exactly the version + generatedFrom lines.

ownership.evidence: All locations agree on 1.3.2: cat VERSION=1.3.2; package.json L3=1.3.2; package-lock.json L3 and L9=1.3.2; gate-manifest L2 version=1.3.2 and L3 generatedFrom '...@1.3.2'. No mismatch.

boundary.evidence: CHANGELOG.md is the only narrative file edited and only by the release step, matching CONTRIBUTING/ADR-0108. The 5 changelog.d/*.md fragments are deleted; ls changelog.d/ returns README.md only.

ownership.evidence: Single well-formed section '## 1.3.2 - 2026-11-02' (grep -c =1) above '## 1.3.1 - 2026-10-30'. Folded text matches the 5 deleted fragments (ADR-0104, 0107, 0108, 0109, 0110).

error-handling.evidence: Fold left changelog.d clean and the new section is valid markdown with no orphaned/duplicate headers.

boundary.evidence: ADR-0049 defines patch=no change to what a consumer must do; the operative rule is consumer-impact (turns a green consumer red -> at least minor).

ownership.evidence: No folded change turns a currently-green consumer red: git diff v1.3.1 main -- gate-manifest.json ignoring version lines shows the only structural delta is the ADDITIVE consumerRequiredGates array; the installable gates section is byte-unchanged. ADR-0109 documents that consumerRequiredGates are classified only, not installed/run/provenance-compared in any consumer. ADR-0108 steps are contributor actions; ADR-0110 ships docs only. See F1.

findings.question: ownership
findings.note: ADR-0049 lists 'a new capability' (minor) and 'changing the manifest shape' (major example) as higher-tier triggers, and this window added the consumerRequiredGates manifest section (ADR-0109), so the patch call brushes both triggers on their face. It is DEFENSIBLE as a patch because ADR-0049's operative rule is consumer-impact and ADR-0109 proves the new section is dormant (not installed/run/compared in a consumer) with the installable gates section unchanged. Reviewer recommended recording this judgment in the release notes. FIXED: a '_Released as a patch, not a minor_' note was added to the CHANGELOG 1.3.2 section stating exactly this.

findings.question: error-handling
findings.note: The 1.3.2 CHANGELOG documents the ADR-0107 append-log merge driver and immediately notes it was superseded by ADR-0108 within the same unreleased window. Transparent but potentially confusing. Left as-is: the text is the verbatim fold of already-merged, already-reviewed fragments, and rewriting merged changelog text during a release cut is a needless risk.

verdict: PASS (all version locations agree on 1.3.2; folded changelog well-formed; no folded change forces consumer action, so PATCH is justified. F1 recommendation addressed in the CHANGELOG; F2 is low/cosmetic.)
